Kitna jeetna zaroori hai? 🤔

Breakeven win rate = haar ÷ (jeet + haar). Jeet 2R aur haar 1R ho, to sirf 33% jeet pe bhi barabar. Jeet chhoti ho, to 70% jeet bhi kam pad sakti hai.
